note: Written once, at selection time. Nothing downstream reads this file.

candidates.title: Last Seen
candidates.pitch: An event feed running on machine cadence. Every timestamp resets to 2M AGO on the beat — except one row, which stops being rewritten and climbs alone: 9M, 41M, 3H. Nothing goes red. The failure is a number that will not reset. When silence crosses threshold it is delivered as a notification card, then the dots settle into the mark.

candidates.title: All Green
candidates.pitch: A wall of status chips, all green, all connected, all correct. A linear reading head crosses them left to right at constant speed. Behind the head nothing changes — the surface stays perfect. Only the count above it, EVENTS EXPECTED vs EVENTS RECEIVED, drifts apart. The screenshot lies; the arithmetic doesn't.
candidates.salvaged: Winner takes the linear reading head as the brightness edit across feed rows, and the premise that everything on screen stays green while the failure happens.

candidates.title: Where You Already Look
candidates.pitch: Two containers, one panel. The dashboard nobody is watching clips shut; the channel everybody is watching clips open in the same rect, carrying the same source monogram. The film is one object changing surface: the absence relocated from a page you would have to open to a card you would have already read.
candidates.salvaged: Winner takes the alert state wholesale: feed clips shut and the lavender notification card clips open in the identical panel rect carrying the same source monogram — the delivery half of the product truth.

decidedBy: Brand specificity, then continuity. Last Seen dramatises elapsed silence per source — only a monitoring product owns that — using a value already on the site (mono 2m ago). It obeys M5 free: nothing announces the failure, a number stops moving. One panel, one row mounted throughout, so states are property changes. All Green taught less; Handoff was an ending without a first act. Both folded in.
